Dear [Miss Manning](../persons.html#2001),
I am sorry not to have been able sooner to answer you and tell you how much I like your [friend](../persons.html#175)’s [Stone cutter](../others.html#175), whom I shall most gladly have in the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52), though I am afraid it can hardly be before the end of the year, as though in the enlarged size of the Monthly Packet I can generally get a short self-contained story in every month, I am engaged a good deal in advance with them

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
